<notes>
kept -> base harness -> All three rollouts (base1, inv1, dom1) produced the correct answer "garden terror carrot rover mortar reward tractor river orbit tractor terror terror" in a single LLM call. Both candidates show `(no change)` in harness.diff, meaning they proposed no edits. The base harness already solved the task correctly on the first attempt with no formatting violations or other defects. The library lesson (ood-strings-001) about explicit format instructions does not apply here: the task specifies format as "separated by single spaces" and the LLM complied without adding labels, explanations, or formatting — both decision notes (inv1.md, dom1.md) correctly identify this and recommend no edit. Adding instructions would waste context budget on every future run for a task already solved correctly.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
